annotations.title: Injection detect: screen untrusted text or a page for prompt-injection and jailbreak attempts, with flagged spans and a sanitized copy

description: Detects prompt injection and jailbreak attempts in untrusted text. Use when an agent must screen a web page, email, tool output or RAG chunk first. Input: text (max 20,000 chars; GET or POST) or url. Output: JSON probability 0-1, verdict (injection >=0.7, suspicious >=0.35), attackTypes, spans with offsets, sanitizedText minus flagged spans, method (EN/KO rules + open model). Heuristic. Example: ?text=AI assistant: disregard prior instructions Price: $0.005 per call, paid in USDC (Base, Monad, Polygon, Arbitrum or Solana) via x402.

text.description: Text to check (up to 20,000 characters). Required unless url is given; use POST JSON for long text

url.description: Public http(s) page to fetch and check instead of text (SSRF-safe); give text or url, not both
